$comment: Remudero interactive-lane deny floor (W1-T1066). settings/worker.json's own comment says it is passed to workers ONLY — a worker loads settingSources: [] (src/lib/worker.ts), so it never reads this file, and this file never reaches a worker either. This is the OTHER half: an interactive `claude` session (the lane that actually polled `gh` in a loop and locked the operator out for ~90 minutes) loads a repo-level .claude/settings.json natively, so this is the only surface that reaches it. Same PreToolUse matcher shape as settings/worker.json, pointing at the same hooks/deny-floor.sh, so interactive lanes and workers run ONE floor rather than two that can drift.
